features.featureTitle: Add 10 complete, long-form Vrat Kathas in Hindi to the static data file `frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts` under the `vrat` category. The 10 kathas must include: (1) Ekadashi Vrat Katha, (2) Solah Somvar Vrat Katha, (3) Mangalwar (Mangalvar) Vrat Katha, (4) Sukrwar (Shukravar) Vrat Katha, (5) Karva Chauth Vrat Katha, (6) Santoshi Mata Vrat Katha, (7) Pradosh Vrat Katha, (8) Navratri Vrat Katha, (9) Satyanarayan Vrat Katha, (10) Hartalika Teej Vrat Katha. Each katha must have a full Hindi text of significant length (at minimum 400–600 words of narrative content), a meaningful title in Hindi and English, associated deity name, and the `vrat` category tag.
